key_path: create a PayPal account (or log in) at developer.paypal.com - email + password, email confirmation; PayPal typically also verifies a phone number
Developer Dashboard > Apps & Credentials (Sandbox): a Default Application already exists
POST api-m.sandbox.paypal.com/v1/oauth2/token with client_credentials to get an access token (agent can do this)
live: PayPal Business account required (business verification); US-only testing on a personal developer account

agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: yes - mcp.paypal.com and mcp.sandbox.paypal.com both expose registration_endpoint /register with PKCE S256
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: partial - client_credentials exchange turns app credentials into short-lived access tokens; apps themselves created in Dashboard
agent_native_auth.scoped_restricted_keys: partial - app-level feature scopes in Apps & Credentials
agent_native_auth.test_mode_sandbox: yes - full sandbox with auto-created sandbox business/personal accounts and default app

mcp.type: product MCP (invoices, orders, subscriptions, disputes, etc. via agent toolkit)

remote.url: https://mcp.paypal.com (prod) / https://mcp.sandbox.paypal.com (sandbox); paths /sse and /http, /mcp also responds
remote.auth: OAuth with DCR (login with PayPal account)

one_click: none found; docs show mcp-remote configs for Claude Desktop/Cursor

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: https://developer.paypal.com/llms.txt (sectioned index pointing to per-section llms.txt files)
docs_for_agents.other: AI resources hub /ai-tools/get-started, Agent toolkit, LLM integration guide

score_justification: Sandbox remote MCP with OAuth-DCR and a pre-created default sandbox app are great, but getting there needs a full PayPal consumer-grade account signup.
best_practice: Separate sandbox MCP host (mcp.sandbox.paypal.com) so agents can be pointed at test data by URL alone.
biggest_gap: Local MCP needs a raw OAuth access token that expires (~hours), forcing manual refresh; no CLI/device login.
